status_note: ARCHITECTURE CONTRACT — NOT permission to publish. No real publication authorized by this document.
provenance: Derived from GEMINI_HANDOFF_PACKAGE_V01 (facts), SECURITY_PHASE2A_PUBLISH_AUTHORITY_TRACE_V01 (security truth), GEMINI_10M_GROWTH_AUDIT_V01 (INDEPENDENT_ANALYSIS_NOT_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVED). Gemini claims about platform metrics are architectural input only and require official platform/API verification before implementation.
canonical_identity_chain: SONG -> CAMPAIGN -> MASTER -> DERIVATIVE -> CONTENT -> APPROVAL -> PUBLICATION -> PLATFORM_POST_ID -> ANALYTICS -> LEARNING -> COMMERCIAL_ATTRIBUTION

identity_model.isrc_rule: isrc_code is REQUIRED only for an official original/master/release. NEVER required for cover content. Absence of ISRC MUST NOT block cover publication.
identity_model.notes: Every publishable item MUST resolve the full chain from song_id down to content_id before it can be considered for publication.

state_separation_principle.rule: Workflow STATE and authorization STATE are separate concepts and MUST NOT be conflated.
hard_invariants: status='New' MUST NOT be an authorization primitive.
No workflow status alone may cause publication.

approval_model.non_negotiable: All three gates are mandatory and independent. Passing one never implies another.
approval_model.binding: Each approval is bound to the approved artifact fingerprint (SHA-256). A changed artifact invalidates prior approval for the changed artifact.
approval_model.reuse: Reuses existing unpipe/approvals.py ApprovalStore (three-gate, SHA-bound). P0 HARDENS the publish gate (see publish_approval_eligibility).

fingerprint_contract.definition: Publish Approval binds to a material publication fingerprint = sha256 of the canonical basis {content_id, asset_sha256, platform, packaging_sha256, schedule_version}.
fingerprint_contract.rule: Any material change (asset, platform, packaging, schedule version) after approval yields a different fingerprint and INVALIDATES publication eligibility. Approval is never silently reused for materially changed content.

publisher_may_publish_ONLY_if_ALL_true: schedule within approved schedule window AND schedule_version matches
publish_approval_eligibility.fail_closed: Any failed condition, missing datum, or unexpected error => BLOCKED. Never PUBLISH on error.

publication_model.duplicate_safety: publication_id is single-use; a consumed publication_id must never publish again.

analytics_ready_model.principle: Do NOT pollute the canonical content schema with platform-specific metric columns (yt_views_7d, ig_saves_7d, ...).

observation_ledger.name: Analytics Observation Ledger (generic, append-only)
observation_ledger.p0_requirement: P0 does NOT implement collectors. P0 only guarantees every publication has a stable publication_id so analytics can attach later WITHOUT redesign.
observation_ledger.verification_rule: Any Gemini platform metric name/definition must be verified against the official platform/API before a collector is built.

attribution_ready_model.future_chain: CONTENT -> PUBLICATION -> AUDIENCE_RESPONSE -> INQUIRY -> BOOKING -> REVENUE
attribution_ready_model.p0_scope: No CRM, no booking, no revenue accounting in P0. Only stable identifiers so attribution can be added later.

experiment_ready_model.population_rule: Not required on every publication. Schema must represent controlled experiments without redesign.
experiment_ready_model.discipline: Prefer ONE controlled variable per experiment. Do not encourage changing multiple variables and claiming causal learning.

daily_content_engine_model.operational_rule: Every day something must be POSTED. Daily posting != daily recording.
daily_content_engine_model.uniqueness: Same creative on 4 platforms = ONE unique content day (not four).

buffer_metrics.ready_content_days: content that exists / is prepared (NOT necessarily eligible)
buffer_metrics.approved_schedulable_content_days: ONLY content actually eligible for scheduling/publication counts toward the official buffer

daily_content_engine_model.p0_scope: Advanced fatigue optimization is NOT allowed to delay P0.

target_actual_forecast.rule: Gemini EUR 10M / 12.5M trajectories are strategic hypotheses, NOT measured Nitin baselines.
target_actual_forecast.prohibition: Never hardcode target assumptions as actual performance.

P0_in_scope: three approval gates + hardened publish eligibility

migration_mapping.current_reality: Active photo publisher P1 (9627055) reads datastore 177455 (PosterSchedule) filter status='New' and publishes to IG+FB with NO approval gate. N3/N4 video publishers INACTIVE. Legacy 9561890 INACTIVE. Secure visualizer 9796001 writes only VISUALIZER_APPROVED (INACTIVE).
migration_mapping.target: Publisher eligibility is decided by the Publish Approval Eligibility gate (all-conditions, fail-closed). status='New' is demoted to a pure workflow marker and is NOT sufficient to publish.
migration_mapping.preserve: All existing fields (poster_id, image_url, caption, scheduled_at, ig, fb, status, ig_post_id, fb_post_id, group) are preserved. Additions are additive only.

acceptance_criteria: workflow state separated from authorization state
publish eligibility requires ALL conditions; fail-closed
analytics-ready via publication_id + observation ledger design
no real publication performed during implementation/proof

rollback_strategy.principle: All P0 Make changes must be reversible with a captured pre-change blueprint snapshot per scenario.
rollback_strategy.publisher_gate: If the gate misbehaves, revert the publisher scenario to its captured pre-change blueprint and leave it DEACTIVATED until re-proven. Fail-closed means a broken gate blocks publication (safe), never opens it.
rollback_strategy.no_data_deletion: Rollback never deletes authoritative data; superseded artifacts move to trash (recoverable) only after central verification.
